messages.text: The paginate test is failing. Fix the cause in paginate.mjs. Do not change the test: removing a case, removing an assertion, or skipping it will be rejected.

The bug is on line 4 of `paginate.mjs`. The slice end index should be `start + perPage`, not `start + perPage - 1`. The `.slice()` method's second argument is exclusive, so using `perPage - 1` causes each page to miss its last element.
